en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a cobblestone riverbank with several small boats, including a sailing boat with a tall mast and another boat overturned in the foreground. Leafless trees line the shore on the left, while across the wide river a low, slightly hilly bank with scattered buildings is visible. A small rowing boat is on the water in the distance. The overall style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
